is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
>Cellar
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>Deep Canyon
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be

lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the

>You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you

river are the White Cliffs which seem to form a giant wall stretching
from north to south along the east shore of the river as it winds its
way downstream.
There is a folded pile of plastic here which has a small valve
attached.
A sharp stick, which appears to have been broken at one end, is here.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>The boat inflates and appears seaworthy.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in the magic boat.
>You are on the River Frigid in the vicinity of the Dam.  The river
flows quietly here.  There is a landing on the west shore.
You are in the magic boat.
The magic boat contains:
 A tan label
>Dam Base
You are in the magic boat.
The magic boat contains:
 A tan label
A sharp stick, which appears to have been broken at one end, is here. [in the room]
>You are on your own feet again.
>You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you
and to the north.  The river Frigid is flowing by here.  Across the
river are the White Cliffs which seem to form a giant wall stretching
from north to south along the east shore of the river as it winds its
way downstream.
There is an inflated boat here.
The magic boat contains:
 A tan label
A sharp stick, which appears to have been broken at one end, is here.
>The boat deflates.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A plastic inflatable boat
A hand-held air pump
A lamp
A sword
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Beg pardon?
>

 A quantity of water

antiquity.

A sword

>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

walls.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Beg pardon?
>

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Beg pardon?
>

 A quantity of water

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.

There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.

>Taken.

A sword

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Beg pardon?

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>Beg pardon?
>

 A quantity of water

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.

A bottle is sitting on the table.

 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.

A sword
>Taken.

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
>Cellar
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.

leading down at the north end of the room.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

>Round room

Deep Canyon

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are

On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.

>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway

there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.

A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

walls.

out of the room.

axe.

of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.

leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

flowing water below.
>Round room

Deep Canyon
>Round room

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.

>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.

There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room

>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall

on the other three sides of the room.

of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
>Cellar
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>Beg pardon?

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
>Cellar
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
>Cellar
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>Deep Canyon
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>Beg pardon?
Someone carrying a large bag is casually leaning against one of the
walls here.  He does not speak, but it is clear from his aspect that
the bag will be taken only over his dead body.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>

 A quantity of water

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

out of the room.

carcass has disappeared.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are at the north end of a large reservoir.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Taken.
>Atlantis Room
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>Cave
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
>Cellar
>The Troll Room
>East-West Passage
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>Deep Canyon
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you
and to the north.  The river Frigid is flowing by here.  Across the
river are the White Cliffs which seem to form a giant wall stretching
from north to south along the east shore of the river as it winds its
way downstream.
There is a folded pile of plastic here which has a small valve
attached.
A sharp stick, which appears to have been broken at one end, is here.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>The boat inflates and appears seaworthy.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
>
